title: How to Deposit Cash at ATMs Without Losing Money on Death?

steps.title: Locate a Functional Leonida Federal ATM
steps.instruction: Search convenience store exteriors, gas stations in Vice Beaches, and bank lobbies in Downtown for glowing green ATM terminals.
steps.tip: Avoid using high-traffic outdoor ATMs in Little Haiti at night as mugging random encounters are frequent.

steps.title: Select Active Character Checking Account
steps.instruction: Interact with the terminal (D-Pad Right). Confirm whether you are depositing as Jason or Lucia. Balances are strictly individual—Lucia cannot draw from Jason's account until joint heist operations unlock.

steps.title: Confirm Wire Deposit Transaction
steps.instruction: Select "Deposit All Dirty Cash" to convert physical street bills into secured electronic credit. Standard transaction fee is 0% at municipal ATMs.

steps.title: Alternative: Wireless Banking via BuckMe App
steps.instruction: Alternatively, open the in-game smartphone and launch the BuckMe peer-to-peer banking app to transfer liquid funds between Jason and Lucia without visiting a physical kiosk.
steps.tip: Keep at least $250 in cash on-person to pay immediate road tolls and emergency bribes.

title: How Does the Car Trunk Weapon Inventory System Work in GTA VI?
tldrAnswer: GTA VI eliminates unlimited weapon wheels. Players carry a strict limit of 2 concealed handguns and 2 slung long guns (rifles/shotguns). All surplus ordnance, heavy rocket launchers, plate armor, and sniper platforms must be stashed in your personal vehicle's trunk armory.

steps.title: Understand Player Inventory Limits
steps.instruction: Jason and Lucia can physically holster 2 handguns (revolvers/pistols) and sling 2 primary weapons across shoulders. Equipping a heavy launcher replaces one shoulder slot.

steps.title: Access the Vehicle Trunk Armory
steps.instruction: Approach the rear bumper of any owned personal vehicle and hold Interact to open the trunk compartment. This displays your full stashed armory grid.
steps.tip: Trunk inventories persist across garage transfers and vehicle impounds.

steps.title: Tailor Ordnance for Mission Objectives
steps.instruction: Swap out weapons before entering a mission zone—stow heavy sniper rifles for distance overwatch or retrieve breaching shotguns for close-quarters room clearances.

steps.title: Reclaim Impounded or Abandoned Vehicles
steps.instruction: If your vehicle is impounded during an arrest, stored trunk weapons remain inside. Pay the municipal impound fee or break into the county lot to recover your armory.

title: How Does the 5-Rank Criminal Profile System Work in GTA VI?
tldrAnswer: GTA VI replaces simple wanted stars with an overarching 5-Rank Criminal Profile system scaling from Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, to Irredeemable. Higher notoriety increases police dispatch severity, facial recognition surveillance cameras, and county-line roadblocks across Leonida jurisdictions.

steps.title: Understand the 5 Notoriety Ranks
steps.instruction: Criminal profiles scale across 5 tiers: Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, and Irredeemable. The Hardened tier introduces tactical SWAT deployments and cross-county dispatch alerts, while Violent and Psycho trigger air support and heavy roadblocks.

steps.title: Navigate Multi-Jurisdiction County Heat
steps.instruction: Crime heat is tracked per county. Vice City Metro Police dispatches do not immediately alert Kelly County Sheriffs or Port Gellhorn Port Authority unless your notoriety is Hardened (Rank 2) or higher.

steps.title: Counter CCTV & Facial Recognition
steps.instruction: Wear bandanas, balaclavas, or sunglasses during bank and store robberies. Security cameras scan unmasked faces, permanently binding the crime to Jason or Lucia's regional rap sheet.
steps.tip: Change clothes and ditch getaway vehicles after losing line-of-sight to bypass surveillance matches.

steps.title: Accelerate Heat Decay at Remote Safehouses
steps.instruction: Lie low in safehouse cabins across Grassrivers or Mount Kalaga National Park where regional law enforcement presence is minimal to drop your profile rating 3x faster.

title: All 6 Confirmed Regions of Leonida & Essential Shops in GTA VI
tldrAnswer: Leonida encompasses 6 core geographic territories: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga National Park. Essential supply chains include Phil's Ammu-Nation, Pay N' Spray, and Pawn & Gun in the base game, plus Rideout Customs, One-Eyed Willie's Mod Shop, and PTT Youngin$ (Ultimate Edition).

steps.title: Vice City (Metropolitan Ocean & Nightlife Core)
steps.instruction: The neon-drenched metropolis spanning Ocean Drive, Starfish Island, Vice Beaches, and Downtown high-rises. Visit Rideout Customs (Ultimate Edition) or local Pay N' Spray for vehicle customization.

steps.title: Leonida Keys (Southern Archipelago & Coral Reefs)
steps.instruction: Subtropical island chain connected by the Overseas Highway. Features maritime dive shops, sunken U-boat wrecks, and coastal boat charters near Big Pine Key.

steps.title: Grassrivers (Central Wetland Marshes & Sawgrass Flats)
steps.instruction: Expansive alligator-infested swamps where bait & tackle depots supply swamp airboats and moonshine transit lines cut through tidal channels.

steps.title: Port Gellhorn (Industrial Freight & Deep-Water Port)
steps.instruction: Western coastal shipping hub hosting underground vehicle transponder fences, container cranes, and heavy industrial cargo docks.

steps.title: Ambrosia & Kelly County (Agricultural Heartland)
steps.instruction: Central farming and chemical heartland featuring Pawn & Gun retailers, PTT Youngin$ (Ultimate Edition) apparel & customization outpost, and agricultural precursor storage facilities.

steps.title: Mount Kalaga National Park (Northern Alpine Summit)
steps.instruction: Leonida's highest vertical peak rising 3,240 feet above sea level. Packed with forestry fire lookouts, hidden glider launches, and Phil's Ammu-Nation mountain outpost.
